name: Filestash Collabora (WOPI) host with WebSocket proxy defaults

steps.title: Web service - Front service
steps.subtitle: Point the template at the hostname that fronts Collabora.

steps.title: Web service - Upstream server
steps.subtitle: Direct the reverse proxy at the Collabora container and keep its WebSockets alive.

steps.title: HTTP - Collabora specific settings
steps.subtitle: Collabora only needs GET, POST, HEAD and OPTIONS and modest request bodies.

steps.title: Security - Rate and connection limits
steps.subtitle: The editor loads many assets and keeps WebSockets open, so the limits sit above the defaults.

steps.title: Security - Bad behavior
steps.subtitle: Ban clients that repeatedly trigger error responses.

steps.title: Security - Headers and exposure
steps.subtitle: Keep the frame headers Collabora sets so Filestash can embed the editor.

steps.title: Performance - Client optimization
steps.subtitle: Compress proxied responses; Collabora serves its own files.
